exposure: Type of MAR (IVF vs. other MAR)
Mode of conception (MAR vs. spontaneous conception)
cohort: 1,953,932 term singleton pregnancies in a national registry from 1999-2011
finding: Term singletons conceived after MAR have an increased risk of morbidity related to birth asphyxia, but this is mainly due to maternal characteristics, as evidenced by comparable risks after propensity score matching.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery for both fetal distress and non-progressive labor occurred more among MAR pregnancies compared with spontaneous conception pregnancies.
